record.original_question: Does every closed simply-connected 4-manifold admit a trisection in which one of the three 4-dimensional pieces is a 4-disk? Equivalently, is every closed simply-connected 4-manifold representable by a trisection having a 4-dimensional sector diffeomorphic to the 4-disk, rather than merely by a trisection in which all three sectors are higher-genus 4-dimensional handlebodies?

evidence.quote: As a consequence, only simply-connected 4-manifolds can admit trisections where one the 4-dimensional "pieces" is a 4-disk. Viceversa, it is an open problem whether each closed simply-connected 4-manifold admits a trisection with this property, or not

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A (smooth) trisection of a closed, oriented, smooth 4-manifold $X$ is a decomposition $X = X_1 \cup X_2 \cup X_3$ into three codimension-0 submanifolds (the "sectors") such that:
(i) each $X_i$ is diffeomorphic to a 4-dimensional handlebody $\natural^{k_i}(S^1\times B^3)$ for some integer $k_i \geq 0$;
(ii) each pairwise intersection $X_i \cap X_j$ ($i\neq j$) is a 3-dimensional handlebody;
(iii) the triple intersection $\Sigma = X_1 \cap X_2 \cap X_3$ is a closed orientable surface.
The case $k_i = 0$ corresponds to a sector $X_i$ diffeomorphic to the standard 4-ball (4-disk) $B^4$.

It is known that if some sector $X_i$ of a trisection of $X$ is diffeomorphic to $B^4$, then $X$ must be simply connected.

Question: Does every closed, simply-connected, smooth 4-manifold $X$ admit a trisection in which at least one of the three 4-dimensional sectors $X_1, X_2, X_3$ is diffeomorphic to the 4-disk $B^4$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of whether every closed simply-connected 4-manifold admits a trisection with a 4-disk sector is described as an open problem in the literature on trisections. Web search returned no result announcing a resolution; only the converse direction (such trisections force simple connectivity) is established, while the existence question for all simply-connected 4-manifolds remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Trisections of 4-manifolds (Gay–Kirby)
status_evidence.snippet: Existence and stable uniqueness of trisections on closed orientable 4-manifolds are established, with sectors diffeomorphic to 4-dimensional 1-handlebodies of varying genera.
status_evidence.claim: General trisections exist with sectors that are 1-handlebodies; the special case where a sector is a 4-disk is not asserted in general.

status_evidence.title: The Trisection Genus of Standard Simply Connected PL 4-Manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Studies minimal trisections of standard simply connected 4-manifolds, computing trisection genera but not resolving whether a 4-disk sector always exists.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on trisections of simply-connected 4-manifolds; no announcement that every such manifold admits a trisection with a 4-disk sector.
